s.how: Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 180ml cold beer and fry at 180C. Serve in 12 small tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime and chipotle mayo.
Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, top with a tin of black beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Add jalapeños and salsa.

m.note: Peter's open house as a realtor
m.how: Spread 8 slices of bread with horseradish cream and fill with 250g roast beef and rocket. Fill 8 more with 250g shredded chicken, avocado and mayo. Cut into quarters.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes and top with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar.

d.note: the rock gig Peter and Sydney go to
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager and serve with ginger beer for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
